aboutHeading: Two trucks, one family, twenty-two years
about:
Bayview Plumbing has been fixing San Diego homes since 2003. Ray started with one truck and a phone number written on the door; today it's still small enough that the person who answers is the person who shows up.

We don't sell you a repipe when you need a washer. You get a flat price before any work starts, and if we can't fix it, you don't pay for the visit.
points: Flat-rate pricing quoted before work starts
One-year warranty on parts and labor

reviews.text: Called at 7am with water coming through the ceiling. Ray was here by 9 and had it stopped in twenty minutes. Charged exactly what he quoted.

reviews.text: Third plumber I called and the only one who actually explained what was wrong instead of just handing me a number. Water heater replaced same day.
